messages:
ben_support: FYI ACME (prod) is seeing JSON parse failures after smart routing swapped variants mid-flight.
acme-infra: Parser error: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value at line 1 column 1. Our ingestion job fails because the payload shape changed.
ben_support: Request IDs they sent: req_0a1b2c3d and req_4d5e6f7g. Timestamp: 2026-02-20T15:12:34Z.
acme-infra: Failing response example they attached:
```json
{
  "id": "resp_123",
  "outputs": {
    "text": "Here is the answer in plain text, not JSON structured output."
  }
}
```
ben_support: Their consumer expects top-level "structured" object with metadata and items[]. The routed fallback dropped that contract.
alex_eng_runtime: Can you confirm the original request included mode=json or Content-Type/application/json semantics? Also need the original X-Redwood-Request-ID and the model header.
sara_prod: Routing log excerpt for req_0a1b2c3d: preferred: rw-structured-7b, fallback chosen: rw-vanilla-7b-compat because structured-7b hit capacity soft-limit. Fallback policy used preserve_shape:false.
alex_eng_runtime: That's the root cause — our compat variants do not support strict JSON-mode and produce freeform text. We should not allow preserve_shape:false when request.mode=="json".
ben_support: Customer repro steps they provided:
1) POST /v1/generate with body: {"prompt":"...","mode":"json"} and header X-Customer-ID: acme-account-123
2) Intermittent responses: sometimes structured JSON, sometimes plain text in outputs.text
3) Downstream parser fails with JSONDecodeError.
sara_prod: Immediate mitigation: pin ACME to rw-structured-7b until fallback policy is changed. Also add a routing guard so requests with mode=json are excluded from compat fallback. Who can push that rule now?
eng-oncall (deploy-bot): deploy created: routing-config/2026-02-20/patch-1825012345 by sara_prod - status: pending approval
bryan_oncall: Acknowledge, grabbing it. I'll disable preserve_shape:false for acme-account-123 and add a hard rule: if header X-Response-Mode=="json" then fallback targets must advertise structured:true.
acme-infra: Please also surface the original request IDs so we can reprocess the failed events: req_0a1b2c3d, req_4d5e6f7g.
alex_eng_runtime: I verified in the router logs both IDs were routed to rw-vanilla-7b-compat at 15:12:34Z and produced outputs.text only. I will open a short-lived transform that wraps compat outputs into the structured schema (best-effort) so ACME's parser can recover while we pin them.
bryan_oncall: Rollback/pin applied. routing-config change deployed to canary then prod. Tests green.
ben_support: Customer confirmed after pinning that reprocessed events parse cleanly. They saw parser errors go to zero.
acme-infra: Reprocess started at 15:45Z, parser errors -> 0. Thanks.
ben_support: Follow-up: file ENG-1234 to add invariant tests in routing to prevent fallback to non-structured variants when mode=json, and update runbook to include quick pin procedure.
alex_eng_runtime: Added runbook note and ENG-1234. Also adding a routing unit test to assert structured contract preservation. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-142 - Smart routing fallback caused schema mismatch; owner: alex_eng_runtime
ben_support: Closing the thread on the customer side but leaving the engineering ticket open for the invariant + test. Will notify ACME when ENG-1234 is complete.
acme-infra: Appreciated, keeping watch and will reopen if anything else crops up.
